q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: The Plus plan costs $4 per month and includes unlimited notes and 3 devices.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: The Team plan costs $8 per user per month, so 5 people would be $40 per month.

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: Yes. Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please email support@example.com with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Refunds for Plus subscriptions are only available within 14 days of purchase, so unfortunately your window has passed. If you have other concerns, I'd be happy to open a support ticket for you.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: No, there is no Linux desktop app. Linux users can use the web app instead.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: No, Android 12 or later is required. Android 11 is not supported.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer:
No, the web app needs an internet connection. The mobile and desktop apps can work offline and sync automatically when you reconnect.

If you need offline access, you can download our iOS, Android, Windows, or macOS apps.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: Go to Settings > Export and select PDF. Your notes will be emailed to you as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select your note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: No, SMS codes are not supported. Two-factor authentication is available through authenticator apps only.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum attachment size on the free plan is 25 MB per file.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: No. You keep paid features until the end of your current billing period.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Your notes are stored in AWS data centers in the United States, encrypted at rest and in transit.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We reply within one business day.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: Plus supports up to 3 devices per account.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: I don't have information about student discounts in our FAQ. I'd be happy to open a support ticket for you—just let me know!

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: I don't have information about HIPAA compliance for Example Notes. I'd be happy to open a support ticket for you to get an answer from our team.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: I don't have information about importing from Evernote in our FAQ. Would you like me to open a support ticket for you?

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer:
Unfortunately, there's no Linux desktop app planned. Linux users can use the web app, which works in any modern browser.

Would you like me to open a support ticket for further assistance?

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer:
I'm here to help with Example Notes questions only. For general programming help, you'll need to look elsewhere.

If you have any questions about our note-taking app, I'm happy to assist!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: I'm here to help with Example Notes only, so I can't assist with weather information.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB each.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Yes, Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Email support@example.com with your order number to request a refund.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックしてください。30分間有効なリセットリンクをメールでお送りします。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: I'm sorry this happened to you. Deleted notes are automatically moved to Trash and kept for 30 days—open Trash, select your notes, and click "Restore." If they're not in Trash, please email support@example.com with your account details so we can investigate further.
